Name: Devastating strike
Description: Deal 1,000 damage in a single hit.

Name: The Devastator
Description: Deal 5,000 damage in a single hit.

Name: Class power
Description: Cast your class spell 100 times (F key).

Name: Weapon master
Description: Defeat 50 enemies with each of the nine weapon families.

Name: Sharpshooter
Description: Defeat 200 enemies with a weapon of the Bow family.

Name: Silent executioner
Description: Defeat 200 enemies with a weapon of the Twin daggers family.

Name: Soul woodcutter
Description: Defeat 200 enemies with a weapon of the Axe family.

Name: Atomic mace
Description: Defeat 200 enemies with a weapon of the Mace family.

Name: Arcane overload
Description: Defeat 200 enemies with a weapon of the Arcane staff family.

Name: Sovereign’s resilience
Description: Survive a fatal blow thanks to the Sovereign’s Crown.

Name: Heartbreaker
Description: Defeat a world boss less than 30 seconds after the first hit.

Name: The great departure
Description: Leave the Dawn Camp for the first time.

Name: Lone walker
Description: Walk 10 km in the open world (one tile = 1 m).

Name: Globetrotter
Description: Walk 50 km in the open world.

Name: Biome tourist
Description: Visit the six regions of the island.

Name: Royal cartographer
Description: Open every secret chest on the island.

Name: First portal
Description: Enter a dungeon or a raid.

Name: Portal collector
Description: Enter every dungeon and raid, on the island and in the Depths.

Name: Celestial pilgrimage
Description: Reach the Needle of the Continuum.

Name: Heart of darkness
Description: Stay 5 minutes in a row in a region stronger than you, without falling.

Name: Lost tourist
Description: Fall in the Enchanted Forest (level 50+) while level 10 or lower.

Name: First fall
Description: Fall in combat for the first time.

Name: Unkillable
Description: Fall 100 times and get back up every time.

Name: Living legend
Description: Complete the story “The Echoes of Dawn”.

Name: Savvy trader
Description: Earn 10,000 gold coins selling to merchants.

Name: Green thumb
Description: Gather an aloe or a star lily.

Name: Master cook
Description: Cook every recipe in the game.

Name: Royal feast
Description: Cook a meal of Mythic quality.

Name: Big fish
Description: Catch a swordfish or an astral moonfish.

Name: Novice enchanter
Description: Own an enchanted piece of gear.

Name: Sovereign’s immortality
Description: Be saved by the Sovereign’s Crown in the middle of a boss fight.

Name: Master Druid
Description: Fill the five talent slots as a Druid.

Name: Eternal Paladin
Description: Fill the five talent slots as a Paladin.

Name: Deadly shadow
Description: Fill the five talent slots as an Assassin.

Name: Lord of the Elements
Description: Fill the five talent slots as an Elementalist.

Name: Epic set
Description: Wear eight Epic or better pieces.

Name: Champion of champions
Description: Defeat all 12 waves of the Arena.

Name: Heroic triumph
Description: Complete the Judgment of Celestia in Heroic mode.

Name: Silver nightmare
Description: Defeat the Blood King in the Bastion.

Name: Time traveler
Description: Defeat the Stellar Devourer in the Needle of the Continuum.

Name: Last judgment
Description: Defeat the Avatar of Judgment less than 3 minutes after the first hit.

Name: Solo challenge
Description: Complete a dungeon or raid alone, without falling.

Name: The price of blood
Description: Defeat a boss while below 5% of your HP.

Name: Lightning speed
Description: Complete a dungeon or raid in under 5 minutes.

Name: Dungeon conqueror
Description: Complete the six dungeons of the island.

Name: Complete bestiary
Description: Defeat every species of the world, dungeons and raids.
